purpose: Session dates for the bounded observation phase that began after 13 Oct 2026. PREPARED FOR INDEPENDENT REVIEW. A date decides nothing until its own entry is REVIEWED with a reviewer, a review time and the official exchange reference.
source: Dates transcribed from QuantDesk backend/app/market_calendar.py at revision 2d1d25a71394455588ba1398f47735fac8a9fdcd, where 2026 is marked provisional. The official source is the NSE F&O trading-holiday circular named in each entry's candidate_reference; it was located by search but its text could not be retrieved during this preparation (nsearchives.nseindia.com timed out), so no date here has been checked against it. Broker calendars are corroboration only.
how_to_review: For each date: check it against the NSE circular and any later exchange notice for the F&O segment; set session_type and hours; copy the circular or notice reference into official_reference (and superseding_notice if one applies); set reviewer and reviewed_at; then set review_status to REVIEWED. Do not mark a date REVIEWED because it appears in QuantDesk's calendar. A SPECIAL session needs its own hours and separately reviewed treatment and is never assessed as a normal 75-observation session.
